question: Does the bounded AS16-111 segment 05 contain enough independently supported density-wedge levels to justify a later Kodak 3401 B&W response feasibility experiment?

development_disclosure.purpose: make the source close mechanically rather than treating one strong edge as a sensitometry curve

branch_rule.automatic_pass: retain source feasibility only and freeze a separate B&W response experiment without using any photograph or colour-stock data
branch_rule.automatic_fail: close segment 05 for response fitting; do not acquire segments 01-04 under this branch and do not reinterpret endpoint/edge evidence as a curve

forbidden: manual region rescue or threshold changes after the report
colour-stock, modern Plus-X, development, scanner-independent or calibrated claim
claim_ceiling: Post-exploratory development-only source geometry audit of one historical Kodak 3401-associated raw-scan segment; no response fit, untouched confirmation, calibration, process, scanner independence or product claim.
